notes.title: Hotfix - widescreen, demo saves, Deck gamepad
notes.content:
Ok, quick hotfix. Thanks everyone for the bug reports! Hit a few of the more annoying issues:

[list]
[*] Widescreen should behave a lot better now
[*] Steam Deck controller issues should be improved
[*] Save games from the demo will hopefully work now
[*] A few text typos
[/list]
